title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
description: Master the four pillars of OOP (Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance, Polymorphism) plus composition and SOLID principles with live interactive class playgrounds.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with variables and functions in any language
outcomes: Model real-world entities cleanly with classes, constructors, and instance methods
Protect internal state using encapsulation, private fields, and validation
Choose wisely between inheritance (is-a) and composition (has-a)
Write extensible code with polymorphism and shared contracts
Apply SOLID design principles to build maintainable architectures
